method: Blind public pass, independent role/task review with real production frontend and local fictional API contracts. No earlier review or tranche report read before this file. Fixture setup code was consulted solely to isolate APIs; product components and cause analysis were not read. Scores remain fixed when historical reports are opened.

verdicts.product: B STRONG PROTOTYPE WITH MINOR FRICTION
verdicts.release: ONE MORE FOCUSED PASS BEFORE TAG

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Independent review completed and quality evidence reached exact cohort.
scorecard.preventsFive: Dense review surface and mobile action search slow the main task.
scorecard.improvement: Give review its own focused work surface.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Welcome and five chapters distinguish Jev answers, AQM scoring and human calibration.
scorecard.preventsFive: Weights/critical rules and wider operational cost still need explanation.
scorecard.improvement: Tighten Define quality; preserve honest exclusions.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Analytics shows exact versions, applicable counts and descriptive caveats; coverage names denominators.
scorecard.preventsFive: Coverage and quality scopes differ; raw statuses make some information harder to interpret.
scorecard.improvement: Keep scope attached to every drill; use human labels.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Core persona tasks completed through real controls.
scorecard.preventsFive: Review density, horizontal tables and scale-format mismatch add detours.
scorecard.improvement: Make primary task actions persistently visible.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Consistent restrained palette, readable typography, clear comparison cards.
scorecard.preventsFive: Long stacked surfaces and broad tables reduce hierarchy.
scorecard.improvement: Collapse supplementary panels and shorten queues.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: AI result preserved; unsaved copy, revision conflict, retention and fictional boundaries visible.
scorecard.preventsFive: This review proves no live provider capability; ordinary technical copy distracts.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Form question summaries avoid raw IDs and types until Advanced details.
scorecard.preventsFive: Conversation metadata, policy/server terminology, review enums and failure strings remain visible.
scorecard.improvement: Remove raw mechanics from routine work.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Roles surface appropriate primary tasks; active secondary groups and breadcrumbs work.
scorecard.preventsFive: Browser Back returned to Welcome from the tested analytics drill; explicit return works.
scorecard.improvement: Make meaningful task transitions restore browser history.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Analytics-to-evidence explicit return, group reuse, pinned forms and review completion connect.
scorecard.preventsFive: Queue remains above the detail; dual policy/schedule saves need care.
scorecard.improvement: Separate the active review from list and analysis context.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Forms, Groups, Answer Sets and Policies have useful one-sentence introductions.
scorecard.preventsFive: Four-level scale can lead to an incompatible format; calibration expects a typed form reference.
scorecard.improvement: Teach compatibility in the picker; offer named form/version choices.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Fresh form and another form reusing three questions were saved locally.
scorecard.preventsFive: Format detour, list-plus-editor height and local/saved libraries add cognitive load.
scorecard.improvement: Let users find the intended reusable standard before choosing its technical format.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Answers and both note types survived evidence; completion reduced 5 to 4 without Refresh.
scorecard.preventsFive: My Reviews action is offscreen at 390px; comparison/queue repeat before inputs.
scorecard.improvement: A focused review page with visible evidence and completion actions.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Overview identifies attention, quality, coverage, open work and health; drills exist.
scorecard.preventsFive: Workload/health fall below coverage; pass rate and some health metrics lack direct action.
scorecard.improvement: Compress coverage and bring workload/health into the initial scan.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Required pages fit 390px; mobile View selectors and resize state worked.
scorecard.preventsFive: Table investigation/review actions require horizontal scrolling; long filter and metadata stacks.
scorecard.improvement: Use task cards or frozen primary actions for reviewer mobile queues.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Four persona keyboard tasks completed; labelled controls, aria-current, sorting and status exist.
scorecard.preventsFive: Long tab sequences; native select replay needed type-to-select; no certification or physical-device proof.
scorecard.improvement: Reduce focus stops and make primary actions easier to reach.

scorecard.evidenceAndWhatWorks: Visual identity stays consistent; public fictional library and authenticated Overview are distinct.
scorecard.preventsFive: Public handoff changes from a clear customer story to raw IDs and a technical table.
scorecard.improvement: Offer a short role/task start with a meaningful sample interaction label.

answerSetVerdict: Strong reusable primitive with format-discovery and mobile-table friction.

topFindings.finding: The primary mobile reviewer action starts outside the visible table.
topFindings.evidence: reviewer-my-reviews-mobile.png; Start review before scroll x=1025.375, width=78.5; after internal scroll x=281.375.
topFindings.impact: A user looking for work must discover horizontal scrolling before the obvious action.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Use review cards or freeze/repeat Start/Continue review beside meaningful interaction labels.

topFindings.finding: Active review is buried beneath the queue and repeated comparison material.
topFindings.evidence: review-detail-start.png: 3773px page; active controls follow queue, evaluation summary, assignment, four comparison metrics and group comparison. Completed desktop page 3826px.
topFindings.impact: Excessive scrolling and attention switching during the primary human task; safe continuity does not make the surface efficient.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Open a focused review work surface; put evidence/answers/save/complete first and comparisons/history behind disclosure.
topFindings.likelyScope: Reviewer detail composition and task navigation.

topFindings.finding: Routine screens still leak technical mechanics and identifiers.
topFindings.evidence: Conversation evidence shows QUEUEID, SESSIONID, raw agent ID and SOURCE before messages; policy editor shows DURABLE POLICY, form ID; evaluations show raw review enums.
topFindings.impact: Colleagues need to translate implementation vocabulary while investigating quality.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Move raw IDs, provider provenance and architecture terminology into Advanced details.

topFindings.finding: Most failure surfaces expose raw errors instead of consistent recovery guidance.
topFindings.evidence: failure-groups has the raw message twice; failure-evaluations looks like an empty results table; settings-save ends with internal-fixture-503. Analytics and partial Overview are better.
topFindings.impact: Users cannot consistently distinguish unavailable data from no results or decide their next safe step.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Reuse the Analytics failure pattern: what failed, retained state, Retry, subordinate Technical details.

topFindings.finding: The reusable clarity scale is absent after the natural Ordered scale choice.
topFindings.evidence: Blind author task picked Ordered scale; picker offered only Customer effort and Service quality. Switching to Multiple choice exposed Resolution clarity v1/v2.
topFindings.impact: A reasonable mental model appears to lose the requested reusable standard.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Show named sets with compatibility explanation and an explicit format-switch action.

topFindings.finding: Calibration question investigation still asks for a technical form reference.
topFindings.evidence: calibration-mobile.png: selecting Questions says Select a form/version; filter placeholder form_id@17.
topFindings.impact: Knowing the human form name/version is insufficient for an easy question breakdown.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Use a named published form/version picker and an obvious drill from the form comparison.

topFindings.finding: Browser Back does not follow the meaningful analytics investigation transition.
topFindings.evidence: Original analyticsTab=questions; drill to evaluations; browser Back reached page=welcome; Forward restored evaluation cohort; explicit Back to Analytics restored Questions.
topFindings.impact: Ordinary browser navigation unexpectedly leaves the investigation.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Push task transitions to history and restore cohort/tab on popstate.

topFindings.finding: Overview hides workload and automation health below a lengthy coverage section.
topFindings.evidence: admin-overview-desktop.png / mobile-admin-overview.png: attention and quality precede coverage, then workload and health; desktop total 3080px, mobile 4756px.
topFindings.impact: The 30-second scan needs scrolling to answer all five primary questions.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Use a compact first-screen workload/health summary with coverage details below.

topFindings.finding: Coverage still groups intentional sampling under Where coverage was lost.
topFindings.evidence: coverage-1000-observations.txt: 500 policy-excluded interactions appear beneath loss heading; subsequent text correctly says intentional.
topFindings.impact: The heading briefly frames a policy decision as failure.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Split Not selected by policy from Content or evaluation gaps.

topFindings.finding: Tiny calculator scenarios round fractional selected work to zero.
topFindings.evidence: public-exercises.json: 1 conversation × 1% × 1 form × 1 request × 1 token displays 0 selected and $0.00.
topFindings.impact: Harmless at ordinary volumes but the displayed estimate obscures small nonzero quantities.
topFindings.recommendedFix: Use less-than labels or fractional planning counts at tiny volumes.

next: One narrowly scoped Reviewer task-focus pass addressing F1 and F2. Other findings remain non-blocking backlog.
